STCT.description: Construction Stage Analysis Control (STCT). Single-instance control record (key is always 1); the boolean gate flags (bLAST_FINAL, iINC_NLA, bINC_PDL, bINC_TDE, bCNS, bITD, bLFFC, bSD) decide which downstream option fields are actually consumed.

bLAST_FINAL.description: Final Stage option. true = use the last stage as the final stage; false = use the stage named in FINAL_STAGE.

FINAL_STAGE.description: [bLAST_FINAL=false] Name of the construction stage to treat as the final stage. Must resolve to an existing stage name.

CPFC.description: Cable pretension force control type (case-insensitive). INTERNAL = initial force; EXTERNAL = external force.

bEXT_REPL.description: External force type. false = Add; true = Replace.

bCALC_CSP.description: Calculate output of each part of composite section.

bAPPLY_IMF.description: Apply initial member force to C.S.

bCONV.description: Convert final stage member forces to initial forces for Post C.S.

bITD.description: Initial tangent displacement for erected structures. When true, ITD (and GROUP when ITD=GROUP) are consumed.

ITD.description: [bITD=true] Initial tangent displacement type (case-insensitive). ALL = all; GROUP = a structure group (requires GROUP). Empty string is treated as ALL. Any other value is rejected.

GROUP.description: [bITD=true & ITD=GROUP] Structure group name for the initial tangent displacement. Must resolve to an existing group.

bLFFC.description: Lack-of-Fit force control. When true, LFFGR is consumed.

LFFGR.description: [bLFFC=true] Structure group name for lack-of-fit force control. Must resolve to an existing group.

bCAMBER.description: Apply camber displacement to C.S. (if defined).

bCHANGE_CABLE.description: Change cable element to equivalent truss element for Post C.S.

iINC_NLA.description: Analysis type. 0 = linear analysis; 1 = nonlinear analysis; 2 = material nonlinear analysis. When 1 or 2, the nonlinear option fields (bIEMF, iLSTEP, iMAXITER, CF, BSSTEP, ADSTEP, bENEG/EV, bDISP/DV, bFORC/FV) are consumed.

iNLA_TYPE.description: Stage option. 0 = independent stage; 1 = accumulative stage.

bIEMF.description: [iINC_NLA=1 or 2] Include equilibrium element nodal forces.

iMAXITER.description: [iINC_NLA=1 or 2] Maximum number of iterations per load step.

BSSTEP.description: [iINC_NLA=1 or 2] Maximum bi-section level for a load step.

bINC_PDL.description: Include P-Delta effect. When true, iITER and TOL are consumed.

bINC_TDE.description: Include time dependent effect. When true, the creep/shrinkage and time-dependent option fields are consumed.

bCNS.description: [bINC_TDE=true] Creep & shrinkage. When true, TYPE and the creep/shrinkage detail fields (bTTLE_CS, bRCE, bOUCC, bITS/iITS, bATS/iT10..iT10K) are consumed.

TYPE.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Creep/shrinkage type (case-insensitive). CREEP = creep; SHRINK = shrinkage; BOTH = creep & shrinkage. iITER_CR/TOL_CR apply only for CREEP or BOTH.

iITER_CR.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true & TYPE=CREEP or BOTH] Number of creep iterations.

TOL_CR.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true & TYPE=CREEP or BOTH] Creep convergence tolerance.

bTTLE_CS.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Tendon tension loss effect (creep & shrinkage).

iTTLE_ES.description: [bINC_TDE=true] Elastic-shortening loss option. 0 = change with variation of tendon force; 1 = constant.

bAPPLY_ELA.description: [bINC_TDE=true] Apply time dependent effect elastic modulus to Post C.S.

bOUCC.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Use only user's creep coefficient.

bITS.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Internal time step for creep.

bATS.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Auto time step generation for large time gap.

iT10.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Auto time step for time gap T > 10.

iT100.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Auto time step for time gap T > 100.

iT1K.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Auto time step for time gap T > 1000.

iT5K.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Auto time step for time gap T > 5000.

iT10K.description: [bINC_TDE=true & bCNS=true] Auto time step for time gap T > 10000.

bSD.description: Consider stress decrease at transfer length zone by post-tension. When true, iSDOPT and SDCONST are consumed.

iSDOPT.description: [bSD=true] Stress decrease method. 0 = linear interpolation; 1 = constant stress (uses SDCONST).

SDCONST.description: [bSD=true & iSDOPT=1] Ratio value for the constant stress type.

iBSC.description: Beam section property option. 0 = constant; 1 = change with tendon.

vEREC.description: Erection load cases to be distinguished from dead load for C.S. output.

EREC.description: Load type for C.S. One of: D, DC, DW, EP, L, W, T, TPG, E, ER.

vLCNAME.description: List of load case names. Each must resolve to an existing static load case.

bSDLE.description: Secondary dead load effect for grid model (Civil/JP builds).

vSDLE.description: Grid analysis load case names for the secondary dead load effect. Each must resolve to an existing grid load case.
